predecessor.preservation_rule: The predecessor remains terminal and immutable; v2 does not retroactively turn it into a passing or metric-authorized experiment.

freeze_timing.disclosure: This is a source-informed successor, not a source-blind preregistration. All source measurements in the pinned compatibility audit were visible before freeze; no BioASQ metric formula, score, rank, percentile, or surfaced bridge output was computed.

successor_change.reason: The predecessor requires sensitivity 20 to pass, but one frozen held-out hard control has target support exactly 10 at its cutoff and is therefore unevaluable at 20 before any metric exists.
successor_change.changed_rule: Remove support 20 from the successor decision and retain primary support 10 plus lower-support sensitivity 5.
successor_change.source_informed_status: The change is explicitly informed by source coverage and weakens independence; it is not evidence that support 20 was scientifically undesirable.
unchanged_rules: all 21 case identities, kinds, cutoffs, and development/heldout splits
source transform and exact descriptor identity
ranking orientation and conservative worst-tie rank
positive, hard-control, and distant-control held-out requirements
zero readiness and no LLM interpretation

case_population.replacement_policy: Do not drop, replace, relabel, or move any predecessor case after source measurement.
case_population.heldout_disclosure: Held-out identities, marginals, direct A-C counts, and candidate-universe sizes are known. Held-out means metric-score-unseen and excluded from formula choice or revision; it is not identity-, source-, or analyst-blinded.

source_compatibility.metric_work_boundary: A formula contract may be frozen only for this successor, never under the terminal predecessor.

source_transform.direct_endpoint_cooccurrences: retain_and_report_exactly; never delete A-C articles for a named case
source_transform.ontology_relatives_policy: Do not remove parent, child, or sibling descriptors before ranking; the hard controls exist to measure that confounder.

metric_inputs_may_not_include: named target identity as a feature
named positive bridge identity as a feature
metric_isolation.development_policy: Development cases may be inspected only after the initial v2 formula contract is frozen. At most one documented formula revision is allowed.
metric_isolation.heldout_policy: Do not compute, cache, log, or persist held-out metric scores, ranks, percentiles, or surfaced bridge outputs until the final post-development v2 formula contract is frozen.

ranking_contract.primary_orientation: rank target C conditioned on seed A

heldout_decision_rule.evaluability_requirement: All 10 frozen held-out cases must be evaluable at support 10 and sensitivity 5; denominator shrinkage is forbidden.
heldout_decision_rule.positive_requirement: At least 1 of 2 held-out source-labelled LION targets ranks in the top 5 percent.
heldout_decision_rule.hard_control_requirement: Zero of 4 held-out ontology-sibling hard controls ranks in the top 5 percent.
heldout_decision_rule.distant_control_requirement: All 4 held-out cross-branch distant controls rank below the median, meaning rank_fraction > 0.5.
heldout_decision_rule.sensitivity_requirement: The three held-out requirements must hold at both primary support 10 and lower-support sensitivity 5; an unevaluable case or disagreement is not a pass.

reporting_requirements: Publish predecessor and successor outcomes side by side; never erase the sensitivity-20 blocker.
Publish all development and held-out ranks, eligible-universe sizes, rank fractions, endpoint marginals, exact A-C counts, and surfaced bridge terms after the final formula freeze.
Keep source-labelled positives, ontology-generated controls, source measurements, and metric outputs structurally distinct.
Report primary-support and sensitivity-5 outcomes even when they disagree.
Label any passing result as source-informed and BioASQ-specific, with zero metric-v3 readiness.
limitations: The successor was designed after case-specific source counts and a held-out coverage blocker were known.
The held-out layer is score-unseen but not identity-, source-, or analyst-blinded.
Removing sensitivity 20 is a disclosed feasibility redesign and can make the successor easier to evaluate than its predecessor.
The source is one secondary 2013 snapshot using MeSH 2013 labels, not period-appropriate historical indexing.
The five positives are source-labelled reproduction cases, not independently adjudicated discovery truth.
The sixteen controls are ontology-generated proposals, not verified absences of relationships or non-academic knowledge.
Public held-out identities make intentional or inadvertent method tailoring possible.
No result contributes metric-v3 readiness, validates a general gap detector, generalizes beyond biomedicine, or authorizes an LLM interpretation layer.
